title.zh: 将北拉瑙省起于巴洛伊的伊利甘—马拉维国家公路、经马通高至利纳蒙的伊利甘—奥罗拉公路的道路改设为国道的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Road Which Starts From the Iligan - Marawi National Highway at Baloi and Traverses Matunggao to the Iligan - Aurora Highway at Linamon, Province of Lanao Del Norte Into a National Road
title.orig: An Act Converting the Road Which Starts From the Iligan - Marawi National Highway at Baloi and Traverses Matunggao to the Iligan - Aurora Highway at Linamon, Province of Lanao Del Norte Into a National Road

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2010/ra_10076_2010.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The road which starts from the Iligan - Marawi National Highway at Baloi and traverses Matunggao to the Iligan - Aurora Highway at Linamon, Province of Lanao del Norte is hereby converted into a national road.
The Secretary of the Department of Public Works and Highways shall issue the necessary rules, orders and circulars to implement the provision of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
